app.name: Backage
app.one_liner: A GitHub-native service that provides dynamic badges and download metrics for GitHub Packages using only free GitHub resources.

screens.name: Badge Dashboard
screens.purpose: Display dynamic badges and package statistics for indexed GitHub Packages across ecosystems like npm, GHCR, Maven, and NuGet.
primary_actions: Check indexing status via release notes

rust_commands.name: fetch_package_metadata
rust_commands.purpose: Scrape and aggregate public package metadata from GitHub using shell-based workflows triggered by stars and queue entries.

rust_commands.name: update_owners_queue
rust_commands.purpose: Add or prioritize user/organization names in the ingestion queue (owners.txt) to trigger package indexing.

mvp_plan: week 1: Generate JSON/XML endpoints for badge rendering
week 1: Implement shell-based scraper using GitHub Actions
week 1: Publish initial index via GitHub Releases
week 1: Set up circular priority queue via owners.txt
acceptance_tests: Given a public GitHub profile with packages, when the user stars Backage, then their packages appear in the index within 24 hours.
Given a self-hosted fork, when configured correctly, then it generates independent badge endpoints without relying on central index.
Given a valid package in the index, when a badge URL is requested, then it returns correct download count and version data.
Given an entry in owners.txt, when the update workflow runs, then the owner’s packages are scraped and added to the dataset.
